tasks.title: Add order lifecycle, dispute freeze and refund; gate escrow release on completion
tasks.change_spec: Add POST /v1/orders/:orderId/start (paid->in_progress, assigned technician only), POST /v1/orders/:orderId/complete (in_progress->completed, requires both before+after evidence), POST /v1/orders/:orderId/dispute (customer/operator -> order disputed, escrow_holds.status=frozen, ledger dispute_freeze event), POST /v1/admin/escrows/:holdId/refund (operator -> hold refunded, ledger refund event crediting customer_refund_payable). Change release-due to join service_orders and require status='completed'.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN a paid order with no evidence WHEN the technician calls complete THEN 409
GIVEN a paid order WHEN the customer disputes THEN order.status=disputed AND escrow_holds.status=frozen AND a balanced dispute_freeze ledger entry exists
GIVEN a frozen hold past release_after WHEN release-due runs THEN released=0
GIVEN a completed order past release_after WHEN release-due runs THEN released=1

tasks.title: Add GET /v1/orders and GET /v1/orders/:orderId so the passport history is server-backed
